name: Boundary Shader
definition: A shader that traces the ray until its value exceeds a user-defined threshold, interpolates the exact threshold position, and illuminates the pixel based on position, precomputed volume normal, and lighting settings.
summary: The Boundary Shader renders the first volume surface exceeding a threshold by interpolating the entry position and computing illumination, differing from standard raycasting by skipping internal integration and from mesh extraction by avoiding intermediate geometry.
